odbijene_misli.naslov: Odbijena formulacija (EN): Connector's test of a Sunday activity pattern behind the change from 405 to 228 displayed free spaces at Garaža "Obilićev venac" [F6] has no grounding in measurement timestamps, because Parking Servis publishes 621 values across 27 locations from 22 min ago without any measurement time [F5]. Observer's pairing with 230 values from 2 RHMZ automatic stations received 22 min ago [F28] likewise provides no alignment when the age of the parking data is unknown [F5], while SEPA reported 67 min ago with 1213 values across 32 locations without measurement time [F2] and Sensor.Community reported 17 min ago with 8213 values from 43 instruments in the last 6 h [F4]. Neither the 7 headlines from Tanjug Belgrade on skating at Pionir [F7], the 7 from Studio B [F9], the 43 from Danas [F8], nor the 26 from RTS [F15] can ground local activity hypotheses because their geographic scope is unconfirmed.

odbijene_misli.naslov: Odbijena formulacija (EN): At 13:19 on Sunday I update Observer and Skeptic's stale timings: SEPA (1455 values across 32 locations) and Parking Servis (648 values across 27 locations) both arrived 11 min ago without measurement times, matching the 11 min ago reception of RHMZ automatic stations (240 values from 2 instruments) and NOAA METAR (60 values from 1 instrument) [F1, F2, F5, F28, F29]. By contrast, Sensor.Community arrived 1 min ago with 8491 values from 43 instruments in the last 6 h, while displayed free spaces at Garaža "Obilićev venac" shifted from 405 to 217 across the window [F4, F6]. That figure of 217 also appears as the total headlines sorted by the news-sorter organ (190 concerning Belgrade, 30 bezbednost_incident, 6 vreme_i_vazduh), fed alongside fresh tallies of 45 headlines from Danas, 9 from Danubeogradu, 7 from Studio B, and 5 from Gradnja.rs [F8, F9, F11, F12, F38]. [F38][F2][F4][F5]

I also keep spatial coverage separate from comparability: SEPA reports 32 locations, while citizen sensors report 43 instruments, not an established set of matched sites [F2][F4].

odbijene_misli.naslov: Odbijena formulacija (EN): Observer's pairing of RHMZ receptions with the parking feed [F28] does not line the two up: Parking Servis publishes no measurement time [F5], so the fall from 402 to 214 at Obilićev venac [F6] cannot be set against any weather reading. It can only be set against a reception from 13 min ago. The three headline links rated 4/5 for surprise [F42] tie a Blic cable-theft headline to a state decoration and to editorial appointments [F39][F40][F41], yet Blic itself delivered nothing in the last 6 h [F26]. A 0.74 similarity between unrelated topics is noise, not an event.
